sheets.prompt: Interior concept art for a science fiction exploration game: a short vaulted porch of bone-white stone, a bronze bell hanging from its vault, at its far end a tall stone door sunk open into the floor while the bell rings, pale concentric rings of sound spreading from the bell and the lamps on the door's lintel lit; through the door the edge of a chasm and stones hanging in the air. A cloaked adult human traveller of ordinary height with a round jade fluid backpack runs for the door with a little bell-shaped whistle of blue-glazed clay still at their lips, dwarfed by the porch, the door already beginning to rise again. Small bells carved in niches, friezes of three dots over an upward arc. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, bone white stone, warm bronze, blue glaze, pale sky light, rose and lavender shadows, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels.
